# Contributing

Understudy is a personal tool, published as open source in the (bizarre) case that it is useful to someone else. It is not maintained as a project: there is no roadmap, pull requests and issues may go unanswered, and things change when the author needs them to. Expect to get your pull request closed unless it's something I've triaged as an accepted issue or discuseed with me before hand. It is MIT licensed, so fork it freely.
